iluminacion.fuente: LRO LOLA average solar illumination 85S-90S 60 m/px, AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 (fraction of hourly steps over 18.6 years with any part of the Sun visible); Mazarico et al. (2011), Icarus 211, 1066-1081, doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2010.10.030

sombra_permanente.fuente: LRO LOLA permanently shadowed regions 85S-90S 60 m/px, LPSR_85S_060M_201608; Mazarico et al. (2011), Icarus 211, 1066-1081, doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2010.10.030

temp_max.fuente: LRO Diviner Polar Resource Product DLRE_PRP_SOUTH (annual maximum surface temperature, thermal model fit to first mapping year, triangular mesh on Kaguya topography); Paige et al., LRO DLRE LEVEL 5 PRP V2.0, NASA Planetary Data System, LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0, 2018

picos_luz.criterio: 5 pixels of AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 (60 m) with the highest mean solar illumination whose centre falls in the grid, greedy, each at least 1 km from the previous ones (polar stereographic plane); fila/col = grid cell containing the pixel centre; valor = pixel value
picos_luz.fuente: LRO LOLA average solar illumination 85S-90S 60 m/px, AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 (fraction of hourly steps over 18.6 years with any part of the Sun visible); Mazarico et al. (2011), Icarus 211, 1066-1081, doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2010.10.030

notas: IAU centre and diameter (51.8 km); side 70 km = whole crater plus about 9 km beyond the IAU rim circle (origen: mío). The square reaches 106 km from the pole, outside LDEM_875S_5M (75.8 km): LDEM_85S_20M is used. Plane = LOLA south polar stereographic: up = longitude 0°, right = 90° E.
